MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The super glue felt related to the small repairs I might make with my fastener supplies, though I would skip a ten-pack without a specific need.",
    "Practical repair supplies broadly fit my recent hardware purchases, but that connection alone does not make them something I need now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The wire connectors and heat shrink tubing assume a wiring project that my recent washers, bolts, and magnetic hooks do not suggest.",
    "The feeler gauge serves a precise measurement task I have not shown a need for, and the rapid test has no connection to my current hardware interests.",
    "Several large electrical assortments would sit unused without a specific wiring task, so their usefulness in other situations does not make them appealing now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying hardware seems to have been taken as interest in electrical repair supplies generally.",
    "My purchases of assorted fasteners seem to have been treated as interest in any large assortment, even when the parts serve a different purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent choices center on fastening, mounting, and hanging things, especially with magnetic hooks.",
    "The purpose of a supply matters more to me than its broad connection to repairs; bolts and washers do not imply that I need wire terminals.",
    "I rarely interact unless something meets a relevant need, and even a related item like glue is less appealing in a quantity I cannot currently justify."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical hardware but stretched it into an unsupported assumption that I am working on electrical wiring."
}
